description: Scheduled Maintenance Activities on the Distribution Network is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset provides information on Scheduled Maintenance Activities on the Distribution Network operated by E-REDES, organized by geographic location and time period. Planned interventions for a safer and more reliable network. Scheduled electricity supply interruptions allow E-REDES to carry out maintenance, modernization, and reinforcement works on the electricity network in a planned and safe manner. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operation and Quality of Service. The portal shows 2022-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
